target.title: fix: keep task title truncation UTF-16 safe in restart/diagnostic output
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where gateway restart blocker diagnostics, gateway reload logs, and CLI run-loop output could display broken U+FFFD replacement characters when a task title contained an emoji or CJK supplementary character at the 80-character truncation boundary.

Three identical copies of formatTaskBlocker share the same task.title.slice(0, 80) pattern, which cuts at UTF-16 code unit boundaries. Emoji like 🚀 are surrogate pairs (2 code units) and get split.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replace task.title.slice(0, 80) with truncateUtf16Safe(task.title, 80) in all three files.

## User Impact

Task title text in gateway restart diagnostics, reload logs, and CLI run-loop output now displays cleanly truncated text without broken characters.

## Evidence

### Tests
```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/gateway-cli/task-title-truncate-utf16.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```
### Files Changed (4 files, +38/-4)

 src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.ts                       |  3 ++-
 src/cli/gateway-cli/task-title-truncate-utf16.test.ts | 28 ++++++++++
 src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.ts                 |  3 ++-
 src/infra/restart-coordinator.ts                      |  3 ++-
